title: Aqua/AIRS L3 Monthly Standard Physical Retrieval (AIRS-only) 1 degree x 1 degree V7.0

variable.definition: Temperature of the air just above the surface retrieved from AIRS infrared radiances, mean of the ~1:30 am and ~1:30 pm overpasses.

grid.grid_reference: lat0/lon0 are the centre of the south-west cell; rows go north, columns east

processing: one OPeNDAP DAP4 subset per monthly granule: SurfAirTemp_A, SurfAirTemp_D, TotH2OVap_A, TotH2OVap_D (no other fields)
day/night mean = (ascending ~1:30 pm + descending ~1:30 am) / 2, only where both orbits have a value (37622 native cell-months with a single orbit were left out)
coarsened 1 deg to 2 deg with grids.coarsen (overlap; 1 deg cells nest exactly), cos(latitude) weights, missing native cells left out
valid_fraction = weighted share of the cell's native area with data, per month
time labelled by month start; calendar months without a granule kept as NaN
kept source units (K, kg/m2); stored as float32 with zlib compression
caveats: satellite retrieval under clear and partly cloudy skies (cloud clearing); persistently overcast regions are sampled less
surface air temperature is retrieved, not measured by a thermometer; compare its trends with MERRA-2 T2M as an independent check, not as the same quantity
